Introduction

Sohee is a South Korean singer under SM Entertainment and a member of the boy group RIIZE. He made his debut on September 4, 2023, with the single album "Get A Guitar".

Mnet announced, on January 5, 2025, that Sohee along with BOYNEXTDOOR's Jaehyun have been selected as MCs of "M Countdown" alongside ZEROBASEONE's Sung Hanbin. Their first appearance was on the January 11 broadcast.

Sohee left his role as an MC of "M Countdown" on February 27, 2025. His departure was to allow him to focus on his group's activites.
